user.title: Connect to Ecowitt Gateway/Hub
user.description: This integration is deprecated. Use the official Ecowitt integration instead: https://github.com/Ecowitt/ha-ecowitt-iot

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the gateway/hub
error.invalid_response: The gateway/hub returned an invalid or empty response. Check the device status, configuration and network connection, then check the Home Assistant logs for the raw response.

deprecated.title: Ecowitt IoT integration is deprecated
deprecated.description:
Ecowitt now publishes an official Home Assistant integration that supports the WFC01, WFC02 and AC1100 over the same local API, and is actively maintained. This custom integration will receive no further updates.

Install the official integration (Learn more), check that your valves and switches appear there, update any automations that reference the old entity IDs, then remove this integration.

set_valve_timer.name: Set valve timer
set_valve_timer.description: Open a WFC01 valve for a set number of minutes. The timer runs on the gateway, so the valve closes even if Home Assistant is unavailable.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes to keep the valve open.

set_power_timer.name: Set power timer
set_power_timer.description: Switch an AC1100 outlet on for a set number of minutes. The timer runs on the gateway, so the outlet switches off even if Home Assistant is unavailable.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes to keep the outlet on.

run_by_volume.name: Run by volume
run_by_volume.description: Open a WFC01 valve until the given volume has passed through it, then close it. WFC01 only.
